description.narrative:
The Project Overall Objective: The intervention will lead to strengthening of freedom of expression in Albania through higher trust in Public Service Media
Outcome 1: Management and staff have improved capacity to develop RTSH into a reliable and trustworthy public service provider in the digital media landscape
Outcome 2: Editorial routines and the quality of the content in the local and national news are improved

Insatsens övergripande mål är att stärka yttrandefriheten i Albanien genom att öka förtroendet för Albanska public service/RTSH. Två viktiga delmål är att förbättra RTSH:s förmåga att vara en pålitlig och trovärdig källa i det digitala medielandskapet, och att förbättra redaktionens rutiner och kvaliteten på innehållet i lokala och nationella nyhetsbevakningar. Särskilda delmål gällande jämställdhet, miljö och klimat ingår i samarbetet.

The intervention's overall goal is to strengthen freedom of expression in Albania by increasing trust in Public Service Media in Albania/RTSH. Two key outcomes are improving RTSH’s capacity to be a reliable and trustworthy public service provider in the digital media landscape and enhancing editorial routines and content quality in local and national news. Specific outputs on gender equality and environment and climate change are included in the cooperation.

description.narrative:
Overall, progress is more pronounced under Outcome 2, while achievements under Outcome 1 remain less visible.
A mid-term review commissioned by SR MDO (November 2025) indicates that the project has contributed to increased awareness of public-service journalism principles and has introduced initial approaches to strategic and audience-oriented planning, including foundational steps toward digital news development. However, progress has largely remained at the conceptual level. Persistent challenges such as leadership instability, centralized decision-making, and outdated digital infrastructure have limited the integration of these approaches into routine organizational practices.
- (Outcome 1) A new digital first mindset introduced by the project is emerging in the newsrooms, preparing RTSH for the planned reconstruction of the company and supporting a modern, flexible approach to developing news stories for digital platforms.
- (Outcome 2)Newsrooms at local level have begun systematically measuring public service news data such as gender balance, creating a more structured foundation for improving the public service news Public Service storytelling with new formats, angles, and content ideas are being tested in the newsrooms, supporting the ongoing editorial development.
- (Outcome 2) More stories aimed at younger audiences in the digital news after the development of new target groups.
- (Oucome 2) Strengthened practical skills in mobile journalism (MOJO) for reporters using only mobile phones and lightweight equipment to produce news stories for digital platforms.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
